principles: current-universe use is not automatically survivorship bias
a candidate requires manual call-path review before defect classification
historical sample membership must not be defined by current active universe membership
current metadata must not be silently treated as historical point-in-time truth
current latest scanner state must not define historical labels or sample eligibility
absence from the current universe is not historical OUT_OF_SCOPE evidence

known_safe_paths.src/scanner/reports/research_views.py: Historical scanner views are built from observed scanner rows and run groups; no current universe master is used to define historical membership.
known_safe_paths.src/scanner/research/query_api.py: History queries filter only explicit requested symbols and dates; no current universe master is loaded.
